zeroconf_confirm.title: Bed Projector found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found a Bed Projector at {host}. Enter the local token to connect it.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device: check host and port
error.invalid_auth: Invalid token: use API_TOKEN from the .env file

abort.not_supported: The discovered device is not a compatible Bed Projector

data.opening_list: Doors/windows listed by name (empty: every door/window contact)
data.opening_template: Open doors/windows template (replaces the list: comma-separated names)
data.light_list: Lights listed by name (empty: every light except groups and the projector)
data.light_template: Lights on template (replaces the list: comma-separated names)
data.next_alarm: Next alarm (timestamp sensor, e.g. sensor.phone_next_alarm, or input_datetime)
data.next_alarm_enabled: Alarm enabled (optional: input_boolean telling whether the alarm rings)

show_message.name: Show message
show_message.description: Shows a temporary message over every projector page.

config_entry_id.name: Projector
config_entry_id.description: The Bed Projector that shows the message.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to project, at most 63 bytes; # is removed.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon above the text; a bell when none is chosen.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds before the message disappears: 5-3600, or 0 to keep it until cleared.

level.name: Level
level.description: Icon colour; without a chosen icon, warnings and alerts show a triangle. An alert also has red text.

blink.name: Blink
blink.description: The projection pulses for the first minute, even when it is off.

clear_message.name: Clear message
clear_message.description: Removes the projector's message right away.
